patterns.message: Use the '@/' path alias for cross-folder imports. Relative imports are only allowed for same-folder siblings (./).
Use the '@/' path alias for cross-folder imports. Relative imports are only allowed for same-folder siblings (./).
shared/ must not import from features/. Invert the dependency: expose a slot/prop and let app/ pass the feature component in.
Modules must not import from app/. Routes depend on features/ and shared/, never the reverse.
Use the '@/' path alias for cross-folder imports. Relative imports are only allowed for same-folder siblings (./).
Feature internals are private. Import types, constants and helpers via the feature barrel ('@/features/<name>'); only 'components/<Component>' may be imported by path.

Constitution VII: a barrel must not re-export a client component. The App Router registers every client component reachable from a barrel in the route's client-reference manifest, so this pulls the whole feature into any route that imports it. Let consumers import the component by path.
